svg.metadata: Target Sudan and surrounding Egypt, Libya, Chad, Central African Republic, South Sudan, Ethiopia and Eritrea: Natural Earth 1:10m Admin-0 cultural vectors, WGS84, public domain, via LonnyGomes/CountryGeoJSONCollection commit 5120290da88f3f205f74aa55f3c8fa1f19d1bc8b. Sanganeb reef is below Natural Earth national-scale resolution and is generalized at its UNESCO World Heritage centre point (N19 44 10 E37 26 35) using the UNESCO nomination's documented maximum reef dimensions of 6.5 km north-south by 1.6 km east-west; real Scene coordinate unchanged. Rendered 2026-09-26.
